camel_example: aliyun facebody ListFaceEntities --region cn-hangzhou --Order asc --DbName default --Token 2 --Labels '视觉智能' --Limit 50 --EntityIdPrefix U1 --Offset 1
description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the ListFaceEntities operation for querying a list of face samples
description_zh: 本文介绍查询人脸样本列表ListFaceEntities的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun facebody list-face-entities --db-name default --offset 1 --limit 50 --token 2 --labels '视觉智能' --entity-id-prefix U1 --order asc --api-version 2019-12-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListFaceEntities

parameters.help_en: The start record. Valid values: 0 to 2000
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of samples to display per page. Valid values: 1 to 200
parameters.help_zh: 每页最多显示的样本数目，取值范围1~200
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: When the query results exceed 2000 records, use the Token returned from the previous request as a parameter to query the next page
parameters.help_zh: 当查询结果超过2000条时，需要使用上一次请求返回的Token作为请求下一页的参数
parameters.name: token

parameters.help_en: The custom labels. A maximum of 10 labels are supported. Separate multiple labels with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 自定义标签，最多支持10个标签，多个标签以英文逗号（,）分割
parameters.name: labels

parameters.help_en: The prefix of the sample ID. The prefix can contain digits, letters, and underscores
parameters.help_zh: 样本ID前缀，包含数字、字母和下划线
parameters.name: entity_id_prefix

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:
- asc: ascending order.
- desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh: 排列方式。包括asc（升序）和desc（降序）
parameters.name: order
